name: Utah
standard: WCAG 2.1 (R895-14-3; 'at minimum'); statute requires standards consistent with the most recent WCAG. Section 508 also referenced.

laws.summary: Directs the state CIO to set, by rule, minimum accessibility standards for executive branch websites, procured hardware/software and employee systems that are consistent with the latest WCAG, tested by people with disabilities, with a grievance process to the CIO, updated at least every three years.

Requires agency websites, procured hardware/software and employee information systems created after 2015-06-01 to conform at minimum to WCAG 2.1, or provide full-function alternative access; undue-burden alternatives require CIO approval.

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

applies_to: Executive branch agencies under the state CIO (Title 63A Ch. 16). Local governments are covered only by the ADA Title II floor.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).
ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).

requires: Conform to WCAG 2.1 or provide an alternative method of access with full functionality
Vendors must comply with applicable accessibility standards
Testing protocol including testing by people with a variety of access limitations
Grievance procedure letting people report access issues to the CIO
CIO updates standards at least every three years
Undue-burden alternatives approved by the CIO
mobile: implied — covers websites, procured software and information systems; mobile apps not named.
procurement: Hardware and software procured by agencies must conform; vendors must meet the standards (R895-14-3).
enforcement: Statutory grievance to the state CIO (DTS); utah.gov feedback form or 801-983-0275; ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: The rule text says 'WCAG Version 2.1' without naming a level; secondary sources say AA. The statute's 'most recent WCAG' language arguably points to 2.2, and the rule has not been updated since 2020.
